sentences.en: Exploring Puerto Rico's bioluminescent bays.
sentences.zh: 探索波多黎各的生物发光湾。

sentences.en: If you're seeking an eco-friendly, surreal experience, you should include a bioluminescent bay in Puerto Rico when planning your next trip.
sentences.zh: 如果你在寻找一种环保且超现实的体验，在规划下一次旅行时，你应该把波多黎各的生物发光湾列入行程。

sentences.en: They are rare ecosystems that happen when microscopic single-cell organisms called, oh, I'm probably going to get this wrong, dinoflagulets?
sentences.zh: 它们是罕见的生态系统，当被称为——哦，我大概会把这个词拼错，甲藻？的微小单细胞生物出现时就会形成。

sentences.en: Sure, I got that wrong.

sentences.en: They grow in quantities big enough to produce a glow-in-the-dark effect when stimulated by movement.
sentences.zh: 它们的数量增长到足够大时，受到运动刺激就会产生暗夜发光的效果。

sentences.en: So when you paddle or splash around, these organisms light up in a neon blue-green color.
sentences.zh: 所以当你划船或在水里嬉戏时，这些生物会发出霓虹般的蓝绿色光芒。

sentences.en: And so does everything they come in contact with, giving a star-like reflection to the water.
sentences.zh: 它们接触到的一切也会如此，在水面上折射出星光般的倒影。

sentences.en: They can be found throughout the ocean.
sentences.zh: 它们在整个海洋中都能找到。

sentences.en: However, it is very rare for them to live in high concentrations, enough to be noticeable.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们以极高的浓度生活到肉眼清晰可见的程度是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: To put this in perspective, there must be thousands and thousands of these single-cell organisms to make a gallon of water light up.
sentences.zh: 为了让你有个直观的概念，一加仑的水里必须有成千上万个这样的单细胞生物，才能让它发光。

sentences.en: There are only five ecosystems in the world where the concentration of these planktons is high enough to be considered bioluminescent bays,
